sourceReferences.evidence: Bounded identity/content checks; Probe allocates then slices/copies arrays; per-byte pending.WriteByte and per-call 16KiB read buffer.
Enumerates archive at discovery; known sources become scan candidates; each scan reopens and probes tracked files; snapshots allocated each Poll.
Home defaults to UserProfile but harness explicitly sets TEMP fake Home; ScanInterval defaults to 3s; OutputDirectory static member not used by harness.
Runtime probing is enabled only when explicit Home equals actual UserProfile; TEMP fake Home avoids real profile runtime probing.

sandboxLimitations.provenance: User observation; not independently reproduced by tracker harness.
sandboxLimitations.foregroundWindow: GetForegroundWindow returned 0; tracker harness never calls foreground/input APIs.
sandboxLimitations.specialFolders: Environment.GetFolderPath returned empty in reported sandbox checks; implicit profile/local-app-data paths cannot be assumed representative.
sandboxLimitations.cim: Get-CimInstance was denied; tracker harness does not query CIM or system-wide process metrics.
sandboxLimitations.homeIsolation: Each AgentTracker receives a nonempty Home validated as a child of the new TEMP synthetic-data directory. No real LOCALAPPDATA/Vibedotcom state output.
sandboxLimitations.metricScope: Process-specific Windows CPU, WorkingSet/private memory and I/O counters only. An unavailable required metric raises an error; no fabricated zero or substituted host-wide measurement.

measurementLimitations: Synthetic single-pass workload, not real provider corpus.
Fresh tracker means cold tracker state; OS cache is warm after fixture creation.
Payload BytesRead excludes content probes; process I/O is logical process traffic, not physical disk traffic.
Short-Poll process CPU can quantize to zero; GC allocation counter is approximate and process-wide.
WorkingSet is sampled before/after Poll; it is not a Poll-local peak and includes prior scenarios/setup.
Steady total includes synthetic writers and logging; Poll intervals are recorded separately.
Provided DLL hash matches build copy; Core was not independently rebuilt or source-to-binary verified.
No measurements or synthetic data generation authorized yet; bounded run requires explicit RUN.
measuredLimitations: 60 growing-file ticks took 70.9162339s, exceeding the intended 60s cadence; no claim of exact 1Hz appends or host-normal latency.
Growing Poll wall p95=787.4652ms and max=1916.0623ms; cause is not isolated. Measured sandbox workload only.
Sampled growing RSS varied 3358720..51474432 bytes. Do not treat RSS changes across ordered scenarios as tracker-retained memory or normal-desktop residency.
Observed process CPU intervals are quantized in 15.625ms steps, with zero values and CPU/wall ratios above 100% for short cases; individual short-Poll CPU percentages are unreliable.
Steady whole-process CPU=9000ms includes fixture appends/logging/watchers; Poll+drain CPU=1375ms only includes overlap with captured Poll intervals and omits watcher CPU between Polls.
